description: This file defines a React component 'HorizonRow' that renders a horizon chart using HTML5 Canvas. It includes default properties, drawing logic for positive and negative data bands, and handles updates and unmounting.

classes.name: HorizonRow
classes.description: A React component that renders a horizon chart on a canvas element, visualizing data points with positive and negative bands.

methods.name: drawChart
methods.description: Handles the drawing of the horizon chart on the canvas, including scaling, band coloring, and rendering positive and negative data bands.
